$comment: Height corrections for buildings the June 2010 LiDAR survey (behind the DataSF footprint heights) could not see correctly, because they were built later. Pipeline config only: names here are provenance, never shipped into tiles. Keyed by sf16_bldgid; parcel is checked so a footprint id change fails the build loudly instead of silently mis-applying.

buildings.label: 415 Mission St tower
buildings.source: Completed 2018. Roof height 326 m (1,070 ft), public record (CTBUH Skyscraper Center). The footprint dataset reports a 0.24 m median height here: in June 2010 the site was the old Transbay Terminal ramps.
